verdict.rationale: Agent-oriented docs are a fair question for an MCP registry and connection platform, so the axis applies. Direct probes found no llms.txt (HTTP 404) and no docs.md (HTTP 404), and the shutdown notice says the docs tree has been removed. Nothing in the pack shows Smithery publishing agent-readable docs of its own; the Context7 listing is a third-party server, and the server-card path is publishing metadata, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
